_doc: PROVIDERS-1 (owner, 2026-11-14): code is canonical in GitHub; it runs on one cloud provider at a time per installation, Cloudflare first. The provider mirrors what the loops need (code, issues, records) so loops close there without waiting on GitHub. Ultrastable is tenant 0 and must run entirely on its own provider account. Other providers are ports of the same core contract (core-contract.json), never forks.

canonical.code: github.com/ultrastable: ultrastable, seed, workers, spec, license, ops, .github
canonical.direction: GitHub is master and public face; provider copies are mirrors rebuilt from it

layers.what: seed and charter, self-closing loops, virtual managers, trust ledger, gates
one adapter per provider implementing the same six capabilities
one running organisation on one provider account (tenant 0 is Ultrastable)

providers.state: first; running on the wrong account (deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json)
Python 3 and SQLite from a repo copy
roadmap: Fly.io, Vercel, Deno Deploy, VPS with Docker

true_when: every worker, store, cron and zone of tenant 0 is in the ultrastable account and none in quniverse
every deploy starts from a GitHub merge and lands on that account
the tick on that account closes a loop with no client session
